comment: Machine-readable twin of narration-phase1a.md. `tts` is the ElevenLabs synthesis input (FliHub spelled 'Fly Hub' for pronunciation); `caption` is the on-screen/WebVTT text (correct 'FliHub' spelling). Keep both in sync with narration-phase1a.md.

scenes.caption: This is FliHub, a platform for running sports organizations and their fantasy competitions. This walkthrough covers the first milestone: accounts, organizations, invitations, and roles.
scenes.tts: This is Fly Hub, a platform for running sports organizations and their fantasy competitions. This walkthrough covers the first milestone: accounts, organizations, invitations, and roles.

scenes.caption: Casey Rivera creates an account with an email and password. FliHub sends a verification email right away. After signing in, Casey has no memberships yet — an account alone grants access to nothing. Casey creates the Riverside Disc Golf Club and automatically becomes its Owner.
scenes.tts: Casey Rivera creates an account with an email and password. Fly Hub sends a verification email right away. After signing in, Casey has no memberships yet — an account alone grants access to nothing. Casey creates the Riverside Disc Golf Club and automatically becomes its Owner.

scenes.caption: As Owner, Casey invites Sam Ortiz as a Scorekeeper. FliHub creates a single-use invitation link that expires in seven days; Casey copies it and sends it to Sam directly. Invitation emails themselves are not sent yet.
scenes.tts: As Owner, Casey invites Sam Ortiz as a Scorekeeper. Fly Hub creates a single-use invitation link that expires in seven days; Casey copies it and sends it to Sam directly. Invitation emails themselves are not sent yet.

scenes.caption: Sam opens the link, already signed in with a verified email address — the invitation only works for the exact recipient. One click, and Sam joins as a Scorekeeper. Scorekeepers can see the member list, but cannot manage invitations or roles.
scenes.tts: Sam opens the link, already signed in with a verified email address — the invitation only works for the exact recipient. One click, and Sam joins as a Scorekeeper. Scorekeepers can see the member list, but cannot manage invitations or roles.

scenes.caption: Alex Chen accepts as Admin. Admins can invite Scorekeepers and Viewers, but only the Owner can invite Admins or change roles. Val Kim joins as a Viewer, with the same read-only member view.
scenes.tts: Alex Chen accepts as Admin. Admins can invite Scorekeepers and Viewers, but only the Owner can invite Admins or change roles. Val Kim joins as a Viewer, with the same read-only member view.

scenes.caption: Casey also runs the City League. Users can belong to several organizations at once, see only the ones they belong to, and switch between them — the active organization and Casey's role are always visible in the header.
scenes.tts: Casey also runs the City League. Users can belong to several organizations at once, see only the ones they belong to, and switch between them — the active organization and Casey's role are always visible in the header.

scenes.caption: Every organization has exactly one Owner. When Casey transfers ownership to Alex, the change is atomic: Alex becomes Owner and Casey becomes Admin — the organization is never without an Owner.
scenes.tts: Every organization has exactly one Owner. When Casey transfers ownership to Alex, the change is atomic: Alex becomes Owner and Casey becomes Admin — the organization is never without an Owner.

scenes.caption: The overview page tracks capability progress honestly: Phase 1A is complete and verified, and upcoming phases are shown as planned. That is the whole walkthrough — thanks for watching.
scenes.tts: The overview page tracks capability progress honestly: Phase 1A is complete and verified, and upcoming phases are shown as planned. That is the whole walkthrough — thanks for watching.
